import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { ArrowRight, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Lightbulb, Truck } from 'lucide-react'; const ConsolidationAlerts = ({ alerts }) => { const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false); if (!alerts || alerts.length === 0) return null; return (

Smart Branch Consolidation

Recommendations

Optimize routes by combining nearby branch deliveries.

{alerts.length}

{alerts.length === 1 ? 'Opportunity' : 'Opportunities'}

{isOpen && (
Suggested actions
    {alerts.map((alert, index) => (
  • {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}

    {alert}

    Consolidation opportunity
    • ))}
)}
); }; export default ConsolidationAlerts;
